data.title: [Finno Chat] Fund disclaimer is displayed in chat
data.precondition:
- Logged in to the Main app (Android or iOS)
- A chat room exists where a fund disclaimer notice message has been sent

steps.action: Open the Main app and go to Finnomena Chat
Open the chat room that contains the fund disclaimer message
steps.expected: Chat room opens and scrolls to the latest messages

steps.action: Look at the fund disclaimer message
steps.expected: Disclaimer is shown as a notice message (not a normal chat bubble) with the full fund disclaimer text, readable and not truncated

steps.action: If the disclaimer has a header image, check it
steps.expected: Header image loads at the correct width, with no broken-image icon inside the text
